column3: NKJV has “Priscilla,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Prisca.”
NKJV has “the Lord Jesus Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Lord.” The Aramaic “Marana tha” is translated “O Lord, come!”
NKJV has “our Lord Jesus Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Lord Jesus.”
